<meta>This page contains the opening of the Condensed Empowerment, a foundational text of the Kalachakra Tantra tradition.</meta>

In the Tibetan language: The Condensed Empowerment <note>original: "dBang mdor bstan pa"</note>.

Homage to the glorious Vajrasattva <note>The Diamond Being, representing the primordial purity of the mind</note>.

The King Suchandra <note>The first King of Shambhala who requested the Kalachakra teachings</note> asked:

O Teacher, regarding the seven types of empowerment, and the three types of <unclear>...</unclear>

<summary>This page introduces the Condensed Empowerment text with a formal salutation to Vajrasattva and the beginning of a dialogue between King Suchandra and the Buddha.</summary>
<keywords>Empowerment, Vajrasattva, Suchandra, Kalachakra, Tibetan Buddhism, Shambhala</keywords>
